cohort: The study included 6,949 women who gave birth in 2019 in a tertiary-level hospital in Belgrade, Serbia.
finding: Extreme-cost hospitalization and treatment affected 4.1% of mothers and was significantly more prevalent among older women, first-time mothers, preterm births, and pregnancies ending in cesarean section.
mod_finding: Women undergoing cesarean delivery had four times higher odds of incurring extreme costs compared to those with spontaneous vaginal delivery.
